listing.name: Auto Outfitting
listing.aiSummary: Provides an optimal autofit system that balances the entire fleet using combat statistics and AI flight patterns.

description:
Auto Outfitting
"""""Optimal""""" autofit for Starsector 0.98a+0.98.5a.

Source code
Required mods: None. LunaLib is optional and adds a settings menu (F3).
Updating: Delete the old Auto Outfitting folder in mods/, then extract the new one. Or use TriOS.
Safe to add mid-game

Safe to remove mid-game

No required mods

Disclaimer
Just to preface this whole thing, this was all built on an analysis of numbers of all the different weapons, hulls, ships, and all the information that I could dig up and find on all the mods that I had installed, and vanilla.

It is not necessarily optimal. It is not necessarily the best and it is not necessarily going to do as well as player-built optimized loadouts. But it is "optimal" in the fact that it tries to balance your entire fleet in one shot with very low to no effort from the player.

That is the goal of this entire mod. I apologize, I wish it could be perfection but it shure aint, lmao. Enjoy anyway if you see fit.

Buttons
Optimize fleet and Order fleet weapons show their plan first. Nothing is refitted or ordered until you press Apply to all ships or Queue all.
Optimal (in the refit screen's Autofit list): Fits the selected ship from the weapons, fighters and hullmods available to it, using the mod's own scoring. A hand-built fit can be better.
Optimize fleet: Plans every combat ship in the fleet together from one shared stock, biggest ships first, and lists each ship's changes and CR cost. Apply to all ships fits them. With Place officers ticked, officers move to the ship where they add the most. The player and AI cores stay where they are.
Order fleet weapons: Lists the weapons and fighters the fleet plan is missing, with prices, budget and delivery place. Queue all orders them through custom production. Pressing it again later orders only what is still missing.
Fleet analysis: Shows the fleet's damage mix, fighter roles and weak spots. Changes nothing.
Lock this ship: Keeps a ship out of Optimize fleet and Order fleet weapons.

How ships are fitted

Stock: Optimal uses the sources ticked in the Autofit panel (cargo, storage, market, black market). Optimize fleet uses what the ships carry, fleet cargo, and the storage of the market you are docked at. Order fleet weapons counts cargo and storage at every market, so it does not order what you already have.
Scoring: Weapons and hullmods are picked on combat numbers and on how the game's AI flies the ship. The officer's skills, d-mods and CR count. Scores are estimates from stats and tables. No combat is simulated.
Civilian ships: Freighters, tankers and salvage ships get campaign hullmods and no weapons. OP left over goes into vents and capacitors.
S-mods: Only built in when Build in s-mods is ticked in the Autofit panel. Keeps 5 story points by default.

Getting started

Open the refit screen and pick a ship.
Press Autofit, then click Optimal.
Press Confirm to keep it.

Screenshots
Refit screen: the Order fleet weapons and Optimize fleet buttons.

Optimize fleet: the plan before Apply to all ships.

Order fleet weapons: planning progress, then the order before Queue all.

Compatibility

Modded ships: Ships, weapons, fighters, hullmods and ship systems from any mod are rated from their loaded stats. Mods under Supported mods also get rules for their scripted effects.
Fleet Toolkit: Nothing to change with its default settings. If its Autofit Menu is on, its "Replace Vanilla Button" setting decides which menu the Autofit button opens. Optimal is in the game's menu, so turn that setting off. Optimize fleet and Order fleet weapons are separate buttons.
Ship Mastery System: Turn off its "S-mod autofit option" in LunaLib, or its autofit replaces Optimal.
Bugs: Post here or open a GitHub issue with starsector-core/starsector.log and your modlist.

Supported mods
All optional. Each integration turns on when its mod is enabled.
Large integrations
LunaLib Settings menu (F3).
MagicLib Weapon interference penalties from every mod that sets them.
Ashes of the Domain (Vaults of Knowledge) Order fleet weapons uses AoTD production. Entropy Lance is not fitted.
Random Assortment of Things Order fleet weapons orders at a Frontiers settlement. Alterations stay on ships. Chronos range cap and weapon effects counted.
Emergent Threats (and IX Revival) AI Subsystem Integration is never built in. Drone-only bays, Trinity Worlds drones and range, adaptive subsystems, seeker lenses, repair nanites and weapon effects counted.
United Aurora Federation Secondary Focus bonus, hullmods and weapon effects counted.
Seeker - Unidentified Contact Plague hulls fly plague LPCs only. Plague weapons and LPCs cost CR on other hulls.
Weapon effects
Tahlan Shipworks Weapon effects. Hull rules for Legio Infernalis, Stahlherz and Glanzwurf. Manannan is not fitted.
Diable Avionics Weapon effects. Weapon selectors in built-in slots stay.
Knights of Ludd Weapon effects. Lidar and Knight Refit rules.
Amazigh's Ship Foundry, Valkyrian, Roider Union Weapon effects and hull rules.
Interstellar Imperium, Stardust Ventures, Ship/Weapon Pack, Tri-Tac Expansion, Junk Yard Dogs, Hillock Prototype and Station Tech, Jackundor's Advanced Arms Weapon script effects counted (explosions, arcs, extra hits).
Secrets of the Frontier, THREAT TECH Weapon effects. Fragment weapons scored by the ship's fragment swarm.
Hullmods
Arma Armatura Hullmods with no stat effect are not used as filler.
Industrial.Evolution Weapon effects. Forge World Experiment stats read per ship.
Yunru's Arsenal, Yunru's Hullmods, YunruCore Install hullmods and Let's Bayblade! are not added. Weapon effects counted.
Ship Mastery System Its s-mod slots count. Turn off its S-mod autofit option in LunaLib.
AI Tweaks, Extra System Reloaded - Oddisz Edition, Starship Legends Their hullmods stay through refits. Starship Legends traits count.
Omega Core Everywhere, There Be Juggernaughts, What We Left Behind, Attuned Drive Field Hullmod rules.
Treasure Hunt Treasure Hunt Package valued on civilian ships.
Other mods
Any other mod Weapons, fighters, hullmods and ship systems rated from their loaded stats.

Mod support requests go here or in GitHub issues.

Permissions: Free to use, change and reupload, in modpacks too. No credit needed. Do not sell it.

AI use disclaimer
Some or all code in this mod was created using AI tools:
Code, docs and offline build checks: Claude Opus 5.5 (through Claude Code).
Design and in-game testing: Mjolniar.
Training data: None added. Art: None.

Made by Mjolniar | More: Auto Colonies | all my mods on GitHub
